name: fix-combo-orb
about: The combo orb (mods/groupcombo ComboOrb.as): a 1 % drop from boxes, barrels, sacks and vases, one per player with combo unlocked, starting combo on pickup. Solo on the first bandit keep floor with the chance at 1000 per mille: no orb while combo is locked, an orb at a broken vase once it is unlocked, combo on when stepped on, an orb left alone while already in combo and taken after combo lapses.

steps.pattern: \[HWP:groupcombo\] combo orb in 5 breakable loot tables
steps.name: the orb pool went into the container loot tables
